授業概要
講義と実習を通じて、生物環境科学、環境地理学に関するフィールド調査の手法、安全対策法について実践的に学ぶ。また、地域生態系を構成する全生物種の種目録調査に貢献できるよう、幅広い分類群に対して粗同定を行える幅広い分類学的知識、主要な調査方法を習得する。
Students will learn specialized fieldwork techniques and safety measure methods on biological and environmental science, environmental geography, and integrated earth science. In addition, students learn basics of taxonomy in various groups of animals necessary for persons engaged in biological inventory studies and techniques for handling specimens through practical trainings using arthropods, soil animals and vertebrates as materials.

全体の教育目標
生物環境科学、環境地理学および包括的地球科学等に関する様々なフィールド調査を通じて、地球の生物圏、大気圏、水圏、岩石圏、土壌圏に関する基礎知識を高め、またそれらの歴史的変遷を究明していく中で環境をシステム的に理解し、地球規模の環境問題に総合的にアプローチする能力を養う。
In order to solve environmental problems and make sustainable social system, we aim to clarify the dynamic interactions among geosphere, biosphere, and human activities. Graduate students will be trained through a series of field-based educational programs in the field of biological and environmental science, environmental geography, and integrated earth science. In addition, this class will deliver training in taxonomic skills and field techniques for wide range of organisms to complete the specialist in a regional ecosystem (biota).
